title: Frozen Ocean ABC
hook: Under the ice, a cold ocean keeps moving.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: polished 3D frozen-ocean storybook, aqua ice and deep blue water, friendly animals, strong foreground separation

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child studying the sea-ice boundary and separating marine life from shore and travel objects
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: orient above ice, ice edge and below water before another ecology block
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written sea-ice ecology; links are factual and land/transport targets stay outside the food-web claim
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: above/edge/below cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe position gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. soft bell sparkle after targets over a warm acoustic pulse
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: soft bell sparkle after targets over a warm acoustic pulse
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Build the frozen-ocean song around the boundary between sea ice and water: tiny drifting life supports fish, birds dive, seals and whales surface, while land tools and animals remain clearly outside the marine food web.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child looks above ice, at the edge, and below water; recurring language uses under-ice, surface, edge, drift, dive, breathe and food-web link.
semanticArc: look below to small ocean life and fish
return to shore where sleds and land animals belong
forbiddenGenericLanguage: cold blue words swim back to me
